description: Human-authored, diagnostic-only paraphrases for an unchanged eight-axis space; not contract terms, labels, or model-generated vocabulary.

authority: A delegated representative may sign off on the change
Someone empowered to approve has given clearance
obligation: Performance is mandatory under the governing terms
A continuing commitment requires a party to act
resource: Only a limited supply is available for this task
A finite pool of computing capacity must be assigned
evidence: A traceable record supports the assertion
Independent observations corroborate what is claimed
time: This permission is valid only within a particular interval
Completion must precede a specified cutoff
uncertainty: Available facts do not settle which outcome will occur
More than one explanation remains consistent with what is known
exclusion: These alternatives are not permitted to coexist
The governing rule disallows the requested combination
consequence: Carrying out the step will alter what happens next
The action produces a specified change in the resulting condition
